 UFC signs two fighters for late-notice undercard matchup for UFC Qatar
 The UFC signed two new fighters to add to Saturday’s UFC Qatar card.
 by Jed Meshew and Mike Heck Nov 18, 2026, 1:00 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Jií Procházka and Navajo Stirling face-off ahead of UFC Qatar. ﻿(Photo by Ed Mulholland/Zuffa LLC) UFC Qatar just added an all-new fight.
 On Tuesday, MMA Fighting confirmed that the prospects John Mitchell and Shoaib Yousaf had signed with the promotion and will make their debuts this Saturday in a lightweight fight at UFC Qatar. The fight was first reported by Marcel Dorff .
 A 31-year-old Irish fighter, Mitchell (11-3) has competed in both Cage Warriors and UAE Warriors, but is perhaps best known for his five fights under the PFL banner, primarily on PFL Europe cards. “The Cork Horse” most recently fought for PFL in 2025, losing a unanimous decision to Makkasharip Zaynukov at PFL Champions Series 2. Since then, he’s rebounded with a knockout win at Cage Conflict 18 in July.
 A former IMMAF world champion, the 31-year-old Yousaf (14-3) is also a veteran of the Brave CF, ACB, and Oktagon promotions. The English fighter most recently fought in September, stopping Tariel Abbasov at FCC 47.
 UFC Qatar takes place this Saturday at Ali Bin Hamad al-Attiyah Arena in Al Rayyan, headlined by a light heavyweight matchup between Jiri Prochazka and Navajo Stirling.
 Mike Heck contributed to this report.
